answer: Each identity enrolls one cardiac rhythm in the Zenith registry: a 30s ECG with a 20 POA bond locked 90 days. Each epoch, a fresh nonce triggers a new 30-second sample in 72h; the wharf checks correlation over 0.92 and rejects replays. 100 fakes need 100 hearts and 100 wearables at 30 POA each: 2,000 POA in bonds plus 3,000 POA in hardware, versus 20 POA for one honest user, and hearts get pricier as donors run dry. Two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. An illness-changed rhythm can re-enroll once a year with a clinic note, keeping genuine users in the ocean.
